I could not verify any PubMed paper that reports patients with **OOCYTE/ZYGOTE/EMBRYO MATURATION ARREST 27 (OZEMA27)** due to **TACC3**. The PubMed results I found for TACC3 were either unrelated mechanistic/spindle biology papers or review articles, and none of the fetched records established TACC3 as the genetic cause of this rare disease in patients.

**Verified disease-reporting papers found:** none.
